lines.en: My feet crush through a layer of sugar.

lines.zh: 糖果草地上，我走得很黏。
lines.en: On the candy grass I walk sticky.

lines.zh: 我身上的糖衣一直在响。
lines.en: My candy shell crackles as I move.

lines.zh: 我的腿是棒子，走起来硬。
lines.en: My legs are sticks and move stiffly.

lines.zh: 巧克力河岸太软，我陷进去。
lines.en: The chocolate bank is soft; I sink.
I skirt around a sugar-crystal tower.
Each step flakes a little sugar off me.
My shadow is sweet enough to draw ants.

lines.zh: 这地方的地面全是粉的。
lines.en: Every surface here is pink powder.
I walk leaving syrup footprints.
I bite the road, then walk on.
I never rush; the sugar would crack.
I lick my own hand; it is sour.
The sun slowly melts me.

lines.zh: 我在想自己是什么味道。
lines.en: I wonder what I taste like.
Syrup drips off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这地方静得能听见糖响。
lines.en: It is quiet enough to hear sugar tick.
I count the colored stripes on me.
Ants are chewing my heel.
I am not hungry; I only want to eat.
The wind blows and I go all sticky.
Even my teeth are made of sugar.

lines.zh: 你闻起来一点也不像糖。
lines.en: Not one bit of you smells of sugar.
One bite of me would rot your teeth.
I see your tongue moving.
Is that candy at your belt?
I am staring at your teeth.

lines.zh: 你身后那棵糖树在滴汁。
lines.en: The candy tree behind you is dripping.

lines.zh: 你比糖果世界的石头硬。
lines.en: You are harder than the stones here.
Your hands are clean; a pity.
I am guessing whether you are sweet.
When you blink it looks like licking.
You cracked my sugar coat.
It hurts; sugar grit falls everywhere.

lines.zh: 里面是空的，你看见了吗？
lines.en: It is hollow inside; do you see?
This blow stings a little.

lines.zh: 我又粘回去了，白费力气。
lines.en: I stick myself back; wasted effort.
Not the head; the head is hard.
You knocked my stripes out of line.
My blood is syrup; believe it?
The more you hit, the sweeter I get.
I can still rise, even broken.
Sour? Give me something sour.
I smell what is in your hand.
I want anything sweet.
Shake it once; I follow one step.
My teeth are itching.
Give it and I will clear the path.
I am not picky; wrappers will do.
Something rattles in your pocket. Candy?
I smell sour; my teeth ache already.
Do not hide it; I saw you swallow.
Bump me and your hand turns sticky.
I am brittle; do not push hard.
Touch me and we stick together.
You cracked my sugar coating.
My syrup is on you now.
Do not shove; I would break apart.
That knock cost me a corner.

lines.zh: 我已经黏住你的靴子了。
lines.en: I have stuck to your boot.

lines.zh: 靠太近，我会粘住你的剑。
lines.en: Too close and I glue your sword.

lines.zh: 我们分开时拉出一条丝。
lines.en: We part and a sugar thread stretches.

lines.zh: 我们是糖做的，生不出孩子。
lines.en: We are sugar; we bear no children.

lines.zh: 两根棒子靠在一起就化了。
lines.en: Two sticks leaning melt together.

lines.zh: 我身上没有能生养的地方。
lines.en: There is nothing in me made for bearing.
We only lick each other.

lines.zh: 糖和糖粘住，就算一家人。
lines.en: Sugar stuck to sugar counts as family.

lines.zh: 我的同伴被吃掉了一半。
lines.en: Half of my companion has been eaten.

lines.zh: 我们不会长大，只会变小。
lines.en: We never grow; we only shrink.
Pressed together, our syrup mingles.
There are no small candies in this world.

lines.zh: 我们分开时都少了一块。
lines.en: We part, each missing a piece.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上的一颗酸糖。
lines.en: I pick up a sour candy from the ground.
I put it in my mouth and do not chew.
I keep the wrappers too.
My hand melts as it closes.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根断掉的糖棍。
lines.en: I pick up a broken candy stick.

lines.zh: 掉的东西我都要闻一遍。
lines.en: I sniff everything that falls.
I hide it under a heap of sugar.
My fingers stick to it.

lines.zh: 这块有点脏，我还是拿了。
lines.en: This one is dirty; I take it anyway.

lines.zh: 捡起来时，我掉了一颗牙。
lines.en: Picking it up cost me a tooth.
You crushed my sugar ground.

lines.zh: 你身上的酸味飘过来了。
lines.en: Your sour smell drifts over.
You are not candy, but you can be eaten.

lines.zh: 我听见你咬东西的声音。
lines.en: I hear you biting something.
You are tramping through my candy grove.
Your blood smells salty.
I want to taste what you are.
You stepped on that sugar flower.
You walk too slowly; I can reach you.

lines.zh: 我身上所有的糖都在叫。
lines.en: All the sugar in me is screaming.
I am going to coat you all over.
Candy wrappers rustle in your pocket.
Your back is turned; how nice.
I smell something sweet on you.
You knocked over my candy pillar.

lines.zh: 这片糖林只有我一个主人。
lines.en: This candy forest has one master: me.

lines.zh: 我贴着你，糖浆拖在地上。
lines.en: I trail you, syrup smearing the ground.

lines.zh: 你砍我左边，我从右边绕。
lines.en: You swing left; I come around right.
I wait for you to open your mouth.

lines.zh: 我的甜味会盖住你的鼻子。
lines.en: My sweetness will clog your nose.
You have backed against the candy wall.
No rush; even melted I will stick.

lines.zh: 你的靴子在发黏，走不快。
lines.en: Your boots are sticky; you slow down.
I count the paces you have left.
I watch you from behind a sugar heap.
The moment you stop, I close in.
I drop a piece of candy to bait you.
Your shadow lies on the syrup.

lines.zh: 我把自己压扁，贴在路边。
lines.en: I flatten myself against the path.

lines.zh: 你的汗和我的糖混在一起。
lines.en: Your sweat mixes with my sugar.

lines.zh: 我的糖壳很硬，你砍不穿。
lines.en: My candy shell is hard; you cannot cut it.

lines.zh: 你踩在糖浆里，抬脚很费劲。
lines.en: You are in the syrup; lifting a foot is hard.
I am in the candy pile behind you.

lines.zh: 你手里的酸糖，是从我这拿的。
lines.en: That sour candy in your hand came from me.

lines.zh: 等你喘完这口气，我再上。
lines.en: When you finish that breath, I move.
I set the candy cones on either side of you.

lines.zh: 我用拳头砸你，拳上是糖。
lines.en: I hit you with a fist of sugar.
This blow is sweet enough to ache your teeth.
I fling syrup across your face.
I bite down on your bracer.

lines.zh: 我的糖棍敲在你肋骨上。
lines.en: My candy stick raps your ribs.

lines.zh: 我的拳头碎了，你也伤了。
lines.en: My fist shatters and so do you.
My sugar glues you in place.

lines.zh: 这一下正好打在你旧伤上。
lines.en: This one finds your old wound.

lines.zh: 我舔到你的血了，是咸的。
lines.en: I taste your blood; it is salty.

lines.zh: 我很重，八十点血压着你。
lines.en: I am heavy; eighty points lean on you.

lines.zh: 我的糖片嵌进你的布缝里。
lines.en: My sugar shards lodge in your cloth seams.

lines.zh: 你挡了，糖还留在你手上。
lines.en: You blocked it; the sugar stays on your hand.

lines.zh: 我把整颗糖头砸向你胸口。
lines.en: I swing my whole candy head at your chest.

lines.zh: 我打你时，自己也在掉渣。
lines.en: As I hit you, I shed sugar.

lines.zh: 我的糖壳裂了，里面更黏。
lines.en: My shell cracks, and what is inside is stickier.

lines.zh: 这一拳下去，你手上有糖了。
lines.en: After this punch, you have candy on your hand.

lines.zh: 我把糖浆泼满你的靴口。
lines.en: I pour syrup right into your boot tops.
You raise your shield; I smear candy over it.

lines.zh: 我压下来时，地板也黏了。
lines.en: When I press down, the floor sticks too.
This one is not sweet; it is sour.

lines.zh: 我从糖浆池里被挤出来。
lines.en: I am squeezed out of a syrup pool.

lines.zh: 这片糖林一夜之间长出我。
lines.en: The candy grove grew me overnight.

lines.zh: 我出生时身上还有模子印。
lines.en: I was born still bearing mold marks.

lines.zh: 糖晶在我胸口结成一团。
lines.en: Sugar crystal knotted in my chest.
I landed in a burst of pink powder.
The first thing I did was taste myself.

lines.zh: 糖果世界的风把我吹硬了。
lines.en: The candy wind hardened me.
I used to be only a candy stick.
I opened my eyes on a sweet world.

lines.zh: 我身上的颜色是后来染的。
lines.en: My colors were dyed on afterward.

lines.zh: 这片地上，我这样的很多。
lines.en: Many like me stand on this ground.

lines.zh: 我还没学会走路就会咬。
lines.en: I could bite before I could walk.
Fire softens my edges.
I fall and splash into a puddle of sugar.
Water soaks me and I go soft all over.
The blast makes me a rain of sugar bits.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，像根糖棍。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in me like a candy stick.

lines.zh: 那药水把我身上的甜冲掉了。
lines.en: That potion washes the sweetness off me.

lines.zh: 我饿起来，连自己都想吃。
lines.en: Starving, I want to eat myself.

lines.zh: 雷一打，我全身的糖都跳。
lines.en: Lightning makes all my sugar jump.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有糖，只有我往下掉。
lines.en: No candy in the void, only falling.
